text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Angolan Minister of Petroleum, Albina Assis, said on Thursday that the Zaire Province is now producing some 10,000 barrels of oil per day. The minister said that before the renewal of war between UNITA and the government troops in 1992, Zaire Province produced between 25,000 and 30,000 barrels a day and that she hoped that that level would again be reached in the near future.
- The city of Luanda will be without electricity from 0500 GMT until 1100 GMT on Saturday, the National Electricity Company announced on Thursday.

- The African representative for the World Organisation of Tourism, Ousmane N'diaye, met briefly on Thursday with the Angolan Prime Minister. The two spoke about improving tourism infrastructure in Angola.
